tougher.config.title: Tougher
tougher.config.enabledByDefault: Enable by default on first world load
tougher.config.enabledByDefault.tooltip: Copied into the gamerule once per save. Missing key is true in singleplayer and false on dedicated servers.
tougher.config.tutorialMaxShows.tooltip: SystemToast first-time mechanics per player. 0 disables toasts. Instant denies still use the action bar.
tougher.config.torchYDeny: Deny torches and campfires below Y
tougher.config.torchBurnDays.tooltip: Minecraft days a newly placed torch or campfire lasts before it disappears. Copper torches last twice as long. Right-click a torch with coal or charcoal to add 40 days (80 for copper); that does not make it permanent. Campfires pull one log from a chest within 12 blocks to add another period. 0 = permanent. Lights placed before this setting never burn out.
